commands.notes: Adversarial probe: hand-crafted privileged artifact with host_preflight.kvm_ok=false AND runs[0].pass=true. The if/then block in evidence-privileged.v1.json fires (host_preflight.kvm_ok matches const:false), forcing the runs[].pass constraint to apply. Each item must satisfy pass: { not: { const: true } }. The run with pass=true fails this constraint and is rejected at absolute path ['runs', 0, 'pass']. This proves the canonical anti-mock rule: a privileged test cannot claim success when the substrate is unavailable.

commands.validation_engine_returned: Multiple ValidationError entries raised by jsonschema
commands.notes: Adversarial probe: benchmark artifact smuggles a 'pass' field at the top level AND inside a benchmark item. Rejected at four distinct absolute paths: (1) top-level additionalProperties:false rejects unknown 'pass' at path []; (2) top-level not-required rule fires a second time at path []; (3) items-level additionalProperties:false rejects 'pass' at ['benchmarks', 0]; (4) items-level not-required rule fires again at ['benchmarks', 0]. The dual-rule (additionalProperties:false + not:required:pass) is intentional belt-and-suspenders so the prohibition survives future schema refactors that might loosen additionalProperties.

misleading_class_discriminator.evidence: Every schema sets class to a const string (deterministic/privileged/benchmark/host_preflight). The positive examples each carry the matching const value. The negative-benchmark probe top-level .class='benchmark' so it exercises the const AND the additionalProperties rule in the same artifact.

summary_arithmetic_mismatch.evidence: JSON Schema 2020-12 cannot enforce `summary.total == items.length` or `summary.pass + summary.fail == summary.total`. The schemas document this gap in the README's 'Summary arithmetic' section and require reviewers to reject artifacts where the math does not reconcile. No automated validator can catch this in v1; a future evidence-validate binary (referenced in plan todo 3) is the planned enforcement point.

pass_field_in_benchmark_top_level.evidence: verify_check_4: the negative-benchmark probe includes a top-level 'pass' field AND an item-level 'pass' field. Both are rejected by additionalProperties:false; both are also rejected by the explicit not:required:pass rule at the same level.

kvm_ok_false_with_pass_true.evidence: verify_check_3: the negative-privileged probe sets host_preflight.kvm_ok=false and runs[0].pass=true. The if/then rule in evidence-privileged.v1.json fires when kvm_ok matches const:false; the then clause restricts each runs[] item's pass to { not: { const: true } }. The probe is rejected at ['runs', 0, 'pass'] with 'True should not be valid under {const: True}'.

host_preflight_in_deterministic.evidence: evidence-deterministic.v1.json uses additionalProperties:false at the top level. A deterministic artifact that smuggles a host_preflight object would be rejected by the additionalProperties rule (host_preflight is not in the required set and is not in the properties enum). This is the canonical way to enforce the 'no host_preflight in deterministic' rule at the schema layer.

target_ms_in_deterministic.evidence: Same mechanism as host_preflight_in_deterministic: target_ms is not in the deterministic schema's properties enum, so additionalProperties:false at the top level rejects it. Deterministic lane is reproducible across hosts; per-host target metadata belongs in the benchmark lane.

missing_class_field.evidence: All four schemas declare class as required. An artifact that omits class would fail the required check at the root. Verified by jsonschema: validate({...without class...}) against any of the four schemas returns a 'required' error.

wrong_class_value.evidence: All four schemas declare class as a const (e.g. 'deterministic'). An artifact that sets class='privileged' but uses the deterministic schema would fail the const check. Verified by jsonschema.

privileged_v1.anti_mock_rule: if host_preflight.kvm_ok == false then runs[*].pass != true

benchmark_v1.anti_boolean_rule: additionalProperties:false at top + not:required:pass at top + additionalProperties:false per item + not:required:pass per item

host_preflight_v1.negative_probe_rejected: not-run (no adversarial probe specified; the positive example exercises the full schema including the $defs/tool reference, both controllers arrays, and the blocked_reason=null vs blocker-non-empty contract)
